skill.name: receiving-code-review

content.value_statement: Code review feedback can be unclear, incomplete, or technically wrong. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code a verification workflow before changes are made.
actual_capabilities: Guides agents to read and restate review feedback before implementation.
Prompts verification against the current codebase before accepting suggestions.
Supports technical pushback when feedback conflicts with existing behavior.
Orders multi-item feedback by clarity, severity, and implementation complexity.
Encourages testing each review fix before moving to the next item.
Provides concise response patterns for correct, unclear, and incorrect feedback.
limitations: It does not perform code review by itself.
It does not replace project-specific review rules or maintainer decisions.
It depends on access to the relevant codebase and test commands.
It provides process guidance, not automated patch generation.

use_cases.title: Clarify Review Comments
use_cases.description: Restate unclear feedback and ask targeted questions before editing code.

use_cases.title: Evaluate External Suggestions
use_cases.description: Check whether reviewer suggestions fit the current architecture, compatibility needs, and actual usage.

use_cases.title: Sequence Review Fixes
use_cases.description: Plan fixes by impact and complexity, then verify each change before continuing.
use_cases.target_user: AI coding agents working through review threads

prompt_templates.title: Restate Feedback
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner workflow for understanding a review comment.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to restate the review feedback in plain technical terms. Identify any unclear items before editing code.

prompt_templates.title: Verify Before Editing
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate workflow for checking a suggested change.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to inspect whether the reviewer suggestion is correct for this codebase. Report what evidence supports or contradicts it.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Multiple Fixes
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow for several review comments.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to group review feedback by blocking issues, simple fixes, and complex changes. Create an implementation order with tests for each item.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Technical Pushback
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow when feedback appears incorrect.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to draft concise technical pushback. Cite codebase evidence, explain the risk, and ask for direction when the tradeoff is architectural.

output_examples.input: Reviewer asks to remove a legacy path, but compatibility is unclear.
output_examples.output: The agent checks supported versions, identifies why the legacy path exists, and asks whether to keep compatibility or remove support.

output_examples.input: A reviewer says to implement a larger metrics feature.
output_examples.output: The agent checks actual usage, finds no callers, and asks whether to remove the unused endpoint instead of expanding it.

output_examples.input: A review contains six items, but two are ambiguous.
output_examples.output: The agent states which items are understood and pauses for clarification before making partial changes.

best_practices: Verify review feedback against the codebase before making changes.
Ask focused clarification questions when any required detail is missing.
Test each fix before moving to the next review item.
anti_patterns: Do not implement unclear feedback only because it came from a reviewer.
Do not add unused features to satisfy vague requests for completeness.
Do not use performative agreement instead of technical evidence.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps AI agents evaluate and respond to code review feedback before changing code.

faq.question: Does it run commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides review handling guidance and may suggest verification steps that the agent or user chooses to run.

faq.question: Can it reject reviewer feedback?
faq.answer: Yes. It encourages technical pushback when feedback is incorrect, unsafe, unused, or incompatible with project decisions.

faq.question: Is this only for external reviews?
faq.answer: No. It covers feedback from maintainers, teammates, and external reviewers with different trust levels.

faq.question: How should unclear feedback be handled?
faq.answer: The agent should ask for clarification before implementing related items.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
